name: Steamed Milk Buns
description: Cloud-soft mantou steamed buns eaten plain with condensed milk or alongside a warm bowl of soy milk.
ingredients: a generous handful of shiitake mushrooms
a handful of fresh cilantro, chopped
instructions: Gather and prep the steamed buns and ground pork, measuring everything out so it is ready to go.
Heat toasted sesame oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat until warm but not smoking.
Add the sliced scallion whites and scallions, cooking gently until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the ground pork, season with white pepper, and cook until just done, about 15 mins.
Warm the steamed buns alongside, turning once, until heated through and lightly toasted.
Plate the steamed buns and spoon the cooked mixture over the top.
tips: Prep the steamed buns and ground pork the night before to make busy mornings much easier.
Make a double batch — leftovers reheat beautifully for a quick weekday breakfast.
A squeeze of citrus or a sprinkle of cilantro just before serving brightens up the whole plate.
